description: Use when you must know if a software version is still supported: pass product (python, nodejs, ubuntu, postgresql, ...) and version (3.8.10) for its release cycle, end-of-life date, supported flag. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /software/eol, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Support and end-of-life status only; for known vulnerabilities of a package version use package_risk, of a CVE id use vuln_cve. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
